biggest_catch: Fieldwork's official participate portal promises an 'incentive' but states no amount and no payment deadline — unverifiable on official terms.
catches: Official 5-step flow ends at 'Be Rewarded… receive an incentive' with no dollar figure.
No official payment timing published anywhere on the participant portal.
Third-party claims (payments within 48 hours, $100–$200+ in person) were excluded as unofficial.

c1.evidence: Official participate.fieldwork.com describes the 5-step flow: Sign Up → Tell Us → Qualify → Participate → Be Rewarded.

c2.evidence: No concrete payout in official terms; only 'receive an incentive for your impact'.

c3.evidence: No payout timing in official terms.

c4.evidence: Registration described as free; no fee in official materials.

eligibility: Registered panelists screened per study (in-person, virtual, phone, in-home)
maximize: Not verifiable — do not pursue until Fieldwork publishes official participant pay amounts and timing.
notes: A major facility network, but its public participant terms contain no pay figures or deadlines. Third-party 48-hour payment claims cannot substitute for provider terms.

s5.note: Flow documented, but no pay terms attached.
